concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-adyen-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Adyen processor article for changing the business checking account used for settled-transaction payouts, with document review, authorized-signer and processor-qualified multi-currency boundaries
warnings: Do not apply this Braintree Adyen processor procedure to another processor, region or independent Adyen account.
The source is documentation of an account-change route, not evidence of completed settlement, funding, bank-account acceptance or deposit arrival.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-adyen-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Adyen processor article for per-settlement-currency checking accounts and settlement-currency deposits, with original-application GBP/EUR fee-debit scope and same-country business-checking prerequisites
warnings: The page does not state a broad regional eligibility rule or fee amount; retain only its same-country account prerequisite and GBP/EUR base-currency statement.
Do not transfer these processor-qualified settlement-account and fee-debit details to other Braintree processors.
